core.title: Spring Loaded Pull Chain Bolt, Don-Jo 1540-CP

text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1540 CP, Colossal Pull Chain Door Bolt

This Pull Chain for Tall Doors is great for bolting hard to reach doors. The chain is a whooping 31 inches long so it is great for those extra tall doorways. This Colossal Pull Chain Door Bolt is sturdy. It is huge and strong, so it will be able to secure even the heaviest of doors and gates. In fact, this pull chain bolt measures 6-1/4 inches long from the tip of the bolt to the end of the mounting plate, now that's big!

The pull chain bolt is reversible for in-swing or out-swing doors.

Features and Specifications of the Colossal Bolt with Pull Chain:

  • Finish: Satin Chrome Plated
  • Mounting Plate Length: 4-7/8"
  • Mounting Plate Width: 2"
  • Bolt Projection: 1-1/4
  • Chain Length: 31"
  • Strike Length: 2-3/32"
  • Strike Width: 1-3/32"
  • Strike Mounting Centers: 1-15/32"
  • Bolt Guide Length: 2-11/16"
  • Bolt Guide Width: 1"
  • Bolt Guide Projection: 1-1/32"
  • Chain Guide Length: 1-21/32"
  • Chain Guide Width: 1/2"
  • Comes packaged with bolt guide, chain guide, strike, and mounting hardware.

Sold individually
